data.name: Trivialicious
data.headline: Complimentary | Wed & Sat | 2pm
data.description:
Test out your knowledge at our family friendly trivia! Compete against other family's of the resort, or split your family up into groups to compete against each other! Topics will include but are not limited to: pop culture, music, movies, history, geography, and much more.

Meet at Tropics Cantina at the Main Pool
data.cancellation_summary: Please email the Recreation Department at recreation@paradisepoint.com to inform us of your cancellation.
data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance are eligible for a full refund or credit. If we need to cancel your reservation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances, you will also receive a full refund or credit.

**To cancel or inquire about your reservation, please contact us by phone 619-247-9345**. No-shows and cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation will be charged in full.
data.booking_notes:
You're all set! Please head to the Tropics Cantina at the designated time to participate in the activity! 

Should you wish to cancel, as a courtesy to resort staff and other guests, please simply reply to this email stating you wish to cancel.
